measurement_rule: Freeze one workflow definition and denominator before comparing periods.
Replace every synthetic input with customer-confirmed baseline data before stating a customer result.
Measure the comparison state on the same workflow definition and report limitations and missing data.
Do not annualize or generalize one short observation window without repeatability evidence.
